method: GitHub web pages; read-only shallow, no-checkout Git clones into TEMP; git show of README, tree, LICENSE and representative implementation. No upstream installation, tests or benchmarks executed.
scope: Memory, context recovery, learning and file-based plans from the additional research supplied by the user.

verified: Claude hooks register Setup, SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PreToolUse, Stop and SessionEnd. The Codex manifest registers five of these; it includes commandWindows.
observation.ts normalizes tool events, excludes recursive memory retrieval, supports project exclusions and subagent filtering, then spools locally or sends to a selected server runtime.
The worker parses observer output into observations and summaries; SQLite stores structured records. README describes optional Chroma semantic retrieval.
ContextBudget.ts measures rendered context, removes whole expensive sections/items until it fits a character budget. Progressive search returns compact IDs, then timeline or full observation details.
corrections: The root Apache-2.0 statement in the extra research is correct at this revision.
The README's five-hook summary is narrower than its current actual Claude hook manifest.
Capture is filtered, not literally every tool event. Claude hooks use bash; Windows support is not equivalent to zero dependencies.
repositories.adopt_original_implementation: Durable structured observations, short search results with stable IDs, explicit detail retrieval, bounded resume context and recursive-capture suppression.
repositories.discard_or_defer: Automatic provider-backed summarization, hosted memory, telemetry and global session harvesting; they add cost, configuration and data scope outside the local kit.

verified: SearchIndex implements an inverted index and BM25. HybridSearch fuses ranked BM25, vector and structural graph streams with weighted reciprocal-rank fusion.
The Claude hook manifest contains 12 lifecycle events. Event coverage is reduced for other host adapters.
Keyless mode uses lexical search; vectors require an embedding provider. Existing structural graph data can still contribute. Local embeddings are opt-in and download a model on first use.
Native Windows requires manually installing pinned iii-engine v0.22.1. Engine installer contains platform asset hashes. README recommends WSL2 or Docker as alternative paths.
corrections: BM25 plus embeddings plus graph is capability, not necessarily the default working configuration. Provider-backed compression also requires explicit enabling.
repositories.adopt_original_implementation: Lexical search as a deterministic default; scoped memory records and explicit provenance. Keep a clear extension boundary for optional future semantic retrieval.
repositories.discard_or_defer: iii daemon, four-port runtime, embedding models and automatic graph enrichment for the initial Windows-local kit; their benefit has not been independently measured here.

verified: ContentStore chunks content and stores it in SQLite FTS5 for BM25 retrieval; source/session attribution is retained.
SessionDB persists per-project hook events, session metadata and resume snapshots.
Snapshot builder returns a table of contents with retrieval references; the Codex SessionStart adapter reads persisted context after compact/resume.
Executor launches child processes, captures outputs, uses temporary script paths, filtered environment, timeouts and platform process-tree termination. Shell runtime on Windows is Git Bash.
Security source contains permission pattern and project boundary checks. This review does not establish an OS security isolation boundary.
corrections: The extra source's vague own-license entry can be resolved: ELv2.
Do not equate its use of the word sandbox with a verified container or OS sandbox. The inspected executor uses subprocesses and policy checks.
98 percent context reduction is an upstream claim, not verified by this investigation.
repositories.adopt_original_implementation: Generic technique only: keep lengthy tool output in project artifacts, return bounded previews and searchable references, and checkpoint resumable state.
repositories.discard_or_defer: No source code or prompts copied. Do not bundle ELv2 code into a uniformly permissive kit. No claims of sandbox security or equivalent compression ratios.

verified: task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md carry file-based working state; lifecycle hooks re-inject selected active-plan context.
PowerShell and shell scripts exist for initialization, plan resolution, ledger, phase status, completion and SHA-256 attestation.
check-complete.ps1 is advisory by default. Gate mode is opt-in and bounded by stop_hook_active, a block cap and ledger progress; stalled work can stop.
Plan attestation compares stored hashes before injection. Automatic recovery reads project files; transcript catchup is a separate explicit mode.
corrections: A deterministic Stop gate is optional and deliberately does not guarantee every plan is completed; the implementation escapes recursion/stalls.
repositories.adopt_original_implementation: One canonical durable project state with generated human-readable plan/findings/progress, checkpoint recovery, and bounded continuation.
repositories.discard_or_defer: Avoid a second independent plan store or multiple conflicting stop hooks. Hashes provide drift evidence rather than proof that a plan is correct.

verified: Go implementation indexes local multi-harness session sources and searches them through CLI/MCP; ingest records source and per-file ingestion health.
Ingestion performs credential-pattern redaction. Secret inspection reports marker kind and location rather than the original secret value.
README documents native Windows distributions through Scoop, winget and release ZIP. The POSIX install script itself is not the Windows route.
Default lexical retrieval works without a model/server. Optional embeddings and endpoint probing also exist, despite the short headline emphasizing no embeddings.
corrections: Local and model-free accurately describes the default retrieval path, not every optional feature.
repositories.adopt_original_implementation: Stable local IDs, source-aware retrieval, optional explicit import, redaction before persistence, and honest ingestion diagnostics.
repositories.discard_or_defer: Do not automatically scan all user conversation stores. Do not claim comprehensive secret removal from pattern matching.

repositories.license: MIT declared in package.json; no root LICENSE found in tree
verified: learn-capture.js parses explicit [LEARN] tags from last_assistant_message and stores category, rule, mistake and correction in SQLite through createStore.
session-start.js fetches five recent project learnings and prints the first three, with a LEARNED.md fallback.
src/db/store.ts uses better-sqlite3 with explicit learning records and usage counters.
corrections: No license is too absolute: package.json declares MIT, although no full LICENSE was found.
Every correction automatically becomes a rule overstates the implementation. Capture requires a structured tag emitted in the assistant's final content.
repositories.adopt_original_implementation: Structured lessons with evidence and explicit status, rather than opaque automatic self-modification.
repositories.discard_or_defer: No code copied while license grant text remains unresolved; do not import its rules wholesale.

verified: Task Observer is a Markdown meta-skill with scripts and references, not a training runtime. It records corrections and recurring workflow issues as structured observations.
New-observation script allocates IDs with collision guards and creates files without overwriting them.
Review stages candidate skill updates separately. Interactive review asks for each decision; scheduled review may apply non-escalated changes to staged copies. Live installation remains separate.
corrections: You approve is broadly correct for live activation, but scheduled staged-copy review can run autonomously under its own configured policy.
Although the skill is Markdown, bundled helper commands are bash-oriented; Windows native execution is not verified.
repositories.adopt_original_implementation: Proposal lifecycle with observations, supporting evidence, status and staged promotion; no silent rewriting of live agent instructions.
repositories.discard_or_defer: Do not impose its broad every-session trigger, scheduled review cadence or approval policy on unrelated tasks. No scheduled automation created.

recommended_design.memory: Single project-local SQLite store, explicit record types and provenance, FTS5 or documented lexical fallback, compact search then detail by ID.
recommended_design.working_state: One canonical task graph plus plan/findings/progress views; resume from persisted facts and executable verification receipts.
recommended_design.context: Output artifacts and bounded previews, deterministic retrieval, bounded checkpoints; no claim of semantic compression without an actual model call.
recommended_design.learning: Evidence-backed proposals and separately approved active rules. Confidence is a heuristic statistic, never a probability or evidence of truth.
recommended_design.privacy: Project scope by default, redact before persistence, do not ingest global transcripts automatically.
recommended_design.integration: Shared runtime with adapter-specific event contracts; one hook dispatcher and one state store to avoid duplicated capture.

limitations: No upstream test suites executed; test-file presence is not a passing result.
No performance, retrieval quality, secret-redaction completeness, live host hook behavior or production stability verified.
No star counts refreshed because feature integration, implementation and licenses were the assigned research scope.
This is a representative mechanism audit, not a line-by-line security audit of each repository.
Source links can be constructed as https://github.com/{repo}/blob/{commit}/{source}; all source paths listed were found in the inspected tree.
